# Mom's Cloud Kitchen

> Made By Mom Loved By All

Mom's Cloud Kitchen is a high-growth Indian cloud kitchen and dine-in food franchise brand founded by Aditya Kuttan. Originating in Virar, Maharashtra, the brand delivers 100% pure vegetarian home-style delicacies, authentic South Indian breakfast classics, protein-rich ragi specialties, and Korean pure-veg kimchi ramen. Over 4,000+ orders have been successfully delivered across leading food delivery aggregators.

The brand operates a mission-driven Women Empowerment Initiative, providing culinary training, operational employment, and financial independence to women.

## Franchise Opportunities

Mom's Cloud Kitchen offers two low-capex, high-margin franchise formats with an expected ROI in 6 to 8 months:

### 1. Cloud Kitchen Pro (Delivery Only)
- Format: Delivery-only dark kitchen (Swiggy, Zomato, Direct Ordering)
- One-Time Franchise Fee: ₹4,00,000 (5-Year Tenure)
- Setup & Kitchen Equipment: ₹5,00,000 to ₹6,00,000
- Space Required: 200 to 250 sq. ft.
- Operational Royalty: Flat 5% on monthly net sales
- Chef Dependency: Zero (centralized standardized gravies, premixes, and batter)
- Net Profit Margins: 28% to 35%

### 2. Cloud Kitchen Plus Dine-In Restaurant
- Format: Cloud kitchen delivery hub plus seated quick-service dining
- One-Time Franchise Fee: ₹6,00,000 (5-Year Tenure)
- Setup & Interior Cost: ₹7,00,000 to ₹8,00,000
- Space Required: 300 to 350 sq. ft.
- Operational Royalty: Flat 5% on monthly net sales
- Target ROI: 6 to 8 months

### 3. City Master Franchise
- Cloud Kitchen Territory Master: ₹20,00,000
- Cloud + Dine-In Territory Master: ₹25,00,000
- Exclusive territory rights, sub-franchisee royalty sharing, and supply chain margins.

## Founder Story: Slum to an Entrepreneur

Mom's Cloud Kitchen was founded by Aditya Kuttan:
- Grew up in a slum in Colaba, Mumbai with limited resources but relentless ambition.
- Started his professional journey as a Housekeeping Associate at Café Coffee Day.
- Built a 20-year career in hospitality across India, the UAE, Oman, and Qatar, rising to Head of Operations.
- Founded Mom's Cloud Kitchen in Virar, Maharashtra, scaling to 4,000+ happy customer orders.
- Founder Quote: *"I started my career cleaning floors in a coffee shop. Today, I dream of building a food brand that reaches thousands of homes. The journey is proof that your background doesn't decide your future — your determination does."*

## Women Empowerment Initiative

- Core Philosophy: *"Some people cook to earn a living. We want to give them a platform where cooking becomes their strength, their identity and their path to independence."*
- Vision: Building a community where women transform their lives through culinary skills, stable employment, and financial independence.
